faq_data.question: What is the minimum setup space required for Halucinate attractions?
faq_data.answer: Our attractions range from compact standalone kiosks (30 sq.ft for Massage Chairs and 80 sq.ft for AI Photo Booths) to massive Free Roam VR Arenas requiring 800 - 1,500 sq.ft. We provide turnkey layout CAD blueprints for malls, FECs, and corporate spaces.

faq_data.question: Can Halucinate attractions be rented for corporate events and college festivals?
faq_data.answer: Yes! We offer 1-day to multi-week rental packages across India (Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai) complete with hardware, high-end PC rigs, technicians, and game hosts.

faq_data.question: What is the ROI and payback period for establishing an FEC VR zone?
faq_data.answer: Typical commercial VR arcade zones generate payback within 6 to 14 months depending on footfall. We provide full hardware warranty, game licensing, cloud telemetry, and operator training.

faq_data.question: Do you provide custom game branding for sponsor activations?
faq_data.answer: Absolutely. Our in-house Unreal Engine & Unity developer team embeds custom corporate logos, product 3D models, custom avatars, and branded leaderboards for marketing launches.

faq_data.question: How do we receive quotes and site inspections?
faq_data.answer: Submit our interactive enquiry form with your desired attractions, space dimensions, and budget range. Our tech deployment team will reach out within 2 hours with indicative quotation PDF & layout options.

accessibility.contrast_standards: All text elements meet APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against dark background (#050811). Muted slate text (#8BA2C1 and #94A3B8) exceeds 6:1 contrast.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential continuous kinetic animations in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` conditionals.
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Focus rings on buttons, inputs, tabs, and interactive card checkboxes use `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#00F0FF] focus-visible:outline-none`.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive inputs, buttons, filter chips, and submission states must feature explicit data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow dark cyber theme strictly: Page background is #050811, card surface is #0B1120, neon cyan is #00F0FF.
Implement the 3D VR Headset visual in Hero using Three.js (or high-fidelity interactive Canvas 3D particle mesh) where the VR goggles turn interactively with cursor tracking and neon cyber lighting.
Ensure all 9 attraction products are pre-seeded in the backend database (backend/seed.py and MongoDB) and dynamic via API with graceful fallback data.
Connect the Enquiry Form to FastAPI backend (`/api/enquiries`) saving data into Mongo and generating mock Telegram/Email dispatch alerts.
Include an Admin authentication screen and panel at `/admin` where the admin can add/edit attractions, manage photo URLs, view enquiries, and update SEO hashtags.
Adhere to data-testid conventions on all key buttons, inputs, dialogs, and table rows for automated verification.
Format currency in Indian Rupees (INR ₹) with standard lakhs/crores formatting.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts and gray gradients. Deliver high visual tension, crisp 1px borders (#1E293B / #00F0FF33), layered z-index, and organic kinetic motion.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never write `transition: all`. Use specific `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.sonner_toast: Mount `<Toaster richColors position='bottom-right' theme='dark' />` once and trigger toasts upon enquiry submission and admin CRUD.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_attributes: All forms, inputs, buttons, tab triggers, and card actions must have `data-testid='...'`.
